Package index

Getting started

Create a project and launch the app.

MitoPilot()
Open The MitoPilot GUI
new_project()
Initialize new MitoPilot Project
new_project_userAsmb()
Initialize new MitoPilot Project with user-provided mitogenome assemblies
new_test_project()
Initialize a test project
new_test_project_userAsmb()
Initialize a test project for user-supplied assemblies

Project database

Create, migrate, edit, and export the project SQLite database.

new_db()
Initialize a new project database
new_db_userAsmb()
Initialize a new project database
add_samples()
Add samples to project database
update_sample_metadata()
Update project database metadata.
update_sample_seqdata()
Update sequence files for existing project
backwards_compatibility()
Update old project database for backwards compatibility
export_db_to_csv()
Export project database to CSV

Cluster configuration

Nextflow executor profiles and remote access.

generate_config()
Generate and save a reusable cluster config profile
list_configs()
List available executor configs
mitopilot_config_dir()
MitoPilot user config directory
nextflow_cmd()
Generate Nextflow command to run pipline
tunnel_instructions()
Print SSH tunnel instructions for a headless GUI session
hydra_setup()
Configure the R session environment for the Smithsonian Hydra cluster

Reference databases

Custom assembly and curation databases, and reference selection by BLAST.

custom_assembly_db()
Build custom GetOrganelle and/or MitoFinder reference databases
custom_curation_db()
Generate a custom curation database
fetch_blast_ref()
Fetch and parse NCBI GFF3 annotations and FASTA sequence for a BLAST top hit
fetch_blast_refs()
Fetch NCBI references for many accessions using batched EFetch requests
patch_blast_ref_meta()
Re-stamp per-sample BLAST hit metadata onto a cached reference JSON
compute_blast_ref_alignment()
Pre-compute a whole-genome pairwise alignment of a sample against its BLAST reference and write the result for ingestion into the blast_ref_alignment SQLite table.
get_top_hits_local()
Get top BLASTP hits

Export and quality control

Build submission files and review protein-coding gene outliers.

export_files()
Generate export NCBI files
flag_PCG_outliers()
Flag outlier PCG annotations in an export group
make_PCG_alignments()
Generate HTML report woth PCG alignments
compare_aa()
Pairwise comparison of AA sequences

Pipeline internals

Called by the Nextflow workflows. Not intended for direct use.

annotate()
Mitogenome Annotation Wrapper
annotate_mitos2()
Annotate mitochondrial genomes using MITOS2
annotate_trnaScan()
Use tRNAscan-SE to annotate tRNAs in a mitochondrial genome assembly
annotate_arwen()
Use ARWEN to annotate tRNAs in a mitochondrial genome assembly
annotate_aragorn()
Use ARAGORN to annotate tRNAs in a mitochondrial genome assembly
annotate_mitofinder()
Annotate a mitogenome assembly with MitoFinder (WF2, optional)
coverage()
Map reads to assembly
coverage_trim()
Use coverage info to trim linear assemblies
orf_finder()
Find open reading frames in unannotated regions
rotate_asmb()
Rotate circular mitogenome to start at given gene
run_scaffold_join()
Nextflow entry point: build + persist a joined assembly (file outputs only)
find_mito()
Find the mitochondrial contigs in a user-supplied assembly
select_mito_contigs()
Select mitochondrial contigs from a BLAST screen
circularize_asmb()
Attempt to circularize a linear mitogenome assembly
get_assembly()
Get assembly from database
get_assembly_userAsmb()
Get assembly from database
